title: An 18+ telling of every jaunt
items: Every jaunt in 1812, 1835 and 1904 now has an 18+ telling: the same stops, sources and title, told in full for grown-ups, with the harder history left in.
The Jaunts menu gets an 18+ pill after the grade filters once Settings › 18+ jaunts is on; each 18+ telling sits after the jaunt's grade versions.
